title: Formalizing the Reduced Mahler 3/2 Dynamical System in Lean 4: Exact 1D Slack Reduction, Constructive Coasting Survivors, Conditional Finiteness Theorems, and Certified Transcendence Barriers
description: A 142-file, sorry-free Lean 4.19.0 + Mathlib v4.19.0 formalization of the reduced Mahler 3/2 dynamical system (Z-numbers), developed by Joshua Coon with Astra and Argon AI assistance via GitHub Copilot. Proves the exact 1D minSlack dynamical reduction, the 5-way general Mahler conjecture equivalence with signed integer margin failure on positive stabilized seed branches and unbounded growth of least surviving positive seeds B(N), certified global lower bound B(29) >= 4096, quantitative extensions of Dubickas (2008/2009) proving the full general-base Theorem 1 (with linear-in-W escape N <= 2bW+2a+2), general-base floor-residue non-stabilization, open-regime p >= 2q single-cell escape, the general-base log(q)/log(p/q) carry complexity threshold, Z_{4/3}(1/3, 5/8) = empty (length 7/24 > 1/4, n <= W+8), and explicit O(log xi) escape bounds for unions up to total length 25/36 > 2/3 > 1/2 via backward-forward integer funnel pruning, the Thue-Morse period-doubling Cantor cascade on [c, 1-c] with Fermat-denominator reduction and Mahler binary partition match up to depth 15 on (2/7, 5/7), and the general gap-g window ladder (1/3 < alpha_g < beta_g < 1/2) and g-rung first-defect valuation lock v_2((3^g-2^g)a_0 + 3^(g-1)) = g(j_0+1), plus unconditional exclusions of two-letter mechanical/Sturmian chains, non-stationary oscillating-epoch words, Thue-Morse and Period-Doubling encodings, rapid-growth odd-quotient descent, the 113-step survival and 114-step death of the 55-bit seed 29871555608238677, and certified Diophantine barrier analyses.
